name: The Unsleeping Lamp (Bất Miên Đăng)
effects: The Lamp That Is Not Out
lore: A bronze storm lamp with a wick of twisted pearl-diver's line, lit by Ôn Thủ Đăng in the winter of 913 and never let go out since. He carries it from tower to tower. The hall believes it was the founder's; it was not. He made it the night Kim Sa Trấn drowned (V171).
build_use: The lamp's sustain piece: ward efficiency, soul guard and a seal that relights once when spent.

name: The Breakwater Seal (Trấn Đê Ấn)
lore: A square basalt seal cut by Chân Định Lan in 1205 when she mapped the outer shoals for a sea wall the elders would not pay for.
build_use: A ward-master's offensive seal: seal damage, speed and ward efficiency.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Seal of Kim Sa Tower (Kim Sa Đài Ấn)
lore: The bronze harbour seal of the drowned Kim Sa beacon tower, raised by pearl divers in 920 and kept by Ôn Thủ Đăng ever since. Its face still carries the founder's mark.
build_use: The patriarch's seal weapon: seal attack power, speed and a larger linh lực pool.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Deep-Tide Robe (Thâm Triều Bào)
lore: Sea-silk oiled black and lined with silver-threaded kelp, made by Ôn Thủ Đăng in 940 after the fashion of his sworn brother's clan.
build_use: Soul resistance and steady regeneration to outlast long vigils.

name: Half-Wall Shield (Bán Đê Thuẫn)
lore: A broad curved buckler of iron-bound breakwater slate shaped for standing in a breach while others pass behind.
build_use: Heavy block rating and body shield for holding the line.

name: Jetty-Core Pendant (Thạch Đê Bội)
lore: A fist-sized shard from the old South Jetty foundation wall, bound in copper wire after a storm split the pier.
build_use: Health, status resistance and linh lực for sustained standing.
